data.title: Armed robbers take nearly B30m from Chinese residents of Chon Buri mansion
data.description: CHON BURI: Three armed robbers held the Chinese occupants of a luxury residence at gunpoint before escaping with cash and assets worth a combined nearly 30 million baht on Tuesday.

data.title: Malaysia’s Myanmar bet? Repatriations pave way for diplomacy
data.description: BEIJING — Malaysia’s repatriation of Myanmar nationals ahead of a visit to Kuala Lumpur by the war-torn country’s leader appears to mirror efforts by other Southeast Asian countries seeking to mend ties with Nay Pyi Taw.

data.title: Messi signs off in tears after one last Argentina master class
data.description: BUENOS AIRES — Lionel ⁠Messi delivered one ⁠last master class in ​blue and white on Tuesday as Argentina's captain brought the curtain down on his extraordinary 21-year international career by ​scoring one goal and setting up two others ‌in a 3-0 friendly win over Benin.

data.title: Nobel Peace Prize haunted by the 'spectre' of Trump
data.description: OSLO - Donald Trump's chances of winning the Nobel Peace Prize are seen as minimal, but his "spectre" will cast its shadow over Friday's announcement of the winner in Oslo, experts say.

data.title: Sleep, appetite, gene-editing experts contend for Nobel chemistry prize
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Molecules that regulate sleep and appetite or methods for editing genes are some of the research fields commentators say could be contenders for the Nobel Prize in Chemistry announced on Wednesday.

data.title: Climate champion Australia digging more coal
data.description: SYDNEY - An export boom has prompted Australia's coal mines to expand despite the nation preparing to champion clean energy as lead negotiator for the UN's climate summit.

data.title: US woman who survived botched execution is conscious, speaking: lawyers
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The female inmate who survived a failed execution in a US prison last week is now conscious and speaking, but her prognosis remains unclear, her lawyers said Tuesday.

data.title: Heavy rain in Greater Bangkok from Saturday to Monday
data.description: The Meteorological Department expects heavy rain in Greater Bangkok from Saturday to Monday as the country is reaching the end of the wet season.

data.title: N. Korea's Kim pledges 'invariable support' in Putin birthday letter
data.description: SEOUL - North Korean leader Kim Jong Un pledged his "invariable support" for Russia in a birthday letter to President Vladimir Putin, while hailing Moscow's war in Ukraine as "sacred", state media reported Wednesday.

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Oct 7
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Kamin presents 14th Self-Enquiry show 'Mountain Is Mountain, River Is River'
data.description: Kamin Lertchaiprasert presents the 14th exhibition in his Self-Enquiry project, "Mountain Is Mountain, River Is River", which is running at 31st Century Museum of Contemporary Spirit in Chiang Mai until Dec 19.

data.title: It's all in the mind at Munins' 'Still On'
data.description: Thai artist Munins invites everyone to explore how the mind works through three essential processes during "Still On", which is running at RCB Galleria 5, 3rd floor of River City Bangkok, Charoen Krung 24, until Nov 15.

data.title: Melody Of Life is back at CentralWorld
data.description: Music, art, fashion and sustainability will come together at "Chang Music Connection Presents Melody Of Life 17", as the long-running Bangkok music festival returns to CentralWorld from Oct 16-18.

data.title: Oosterhuis: A giant of game with a sweet 2-iron
data.description: It was a filthy day with non-stop rain pounding the Hilversumsche course and I found myself sitting on a clubhouse couch next to Peter Oosterhuis. Back in 1974, Peter was the man of the moment and was consistently winning tournaments over a ten-year period. We chatted about this and that and he mentioned he was hoping to go out and play, as he was only one shot back. All the other players, who were not in contention, didn't want to go out in the Dutch monsoon. However, the tournament ultimately was reduced to just three rounds and Brian Barnes was declared the winner.

data.title: Comfort vs desire
data.description: Prime Video's A Love Other Than Yours explores the changing emotions of a long-term relationship through four characters searching for love, understanding and connection.

data.title: Quebec's incoming separatist leader wants to block Crown from swearing-in
data.description: MONTREAL (CANADA) - Quebec's incoming separatist premier said Tuesday he plans to block the province's lieutenant governor, a representative of the British Crown, from swearing in the new government.

data.title: Iceland is 'critical outpost' for security, says Rubio during visit
data.description: REYKJAVIK - US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Tuesday that Iceland had long been a "critical outpost" for security during a visit to the island, as his country pushes for greater American influence in the Arctic region.

data.title: Thunder Castle open  Shopee Cup defence
data.description: Defending champions Buriram United will kick off their Asean Club Championship Shopee Cup campaign in Group A, taking on Indonesia's Borneo Samarinda on Wednesday.

data.title: Ten-man Thailand fall short
data.description: Thailand came within one penalty of a remarkable triumph in Jakarta on Monday night as Emil Audero saved Nattapong Sayriya's spot-kick to give Indonesia a 4-2 shootout victory and the inaugural Fifa Asean Cup.

data.title: Powerlifter Kamolpan eyes medal
data.description: Powerlifter Kamolpan Kraratpet, Thailand's sole medallist in the discipline, at the last Asian Para Games, will lead a six-strong team to Japan this month in search of a place on the podium again.

data.title: 2,000 swine drown at flooded farm
data.description: Authorities expect to clear about 2,000 pig carcasses from a flooded farm in Prachin Buri by Thursday, Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit said.

data.title: Higher VAT urged amid net deficit
data.description: The government has reported a net deficit of 760 billion baht for fiscal 2025, as senators called for a higher value-added tax (VAT) and a broader tax base.

data.title: BMA steps up efforts to drain flooded communities
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is accelerating floodwater drainage operations at Rom Klao Community Housing in Lat Krabang district.

data.title: BJT gives its MP benefit of the doubt
data.description: Digital Economy and Society Minister Chaichanok Chidchob has defended Bhumjaithai Party MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap, saying he has seen no evidence linking her husband to scam networks.

data.title: Tribute paid to Oct 6 Thammasat tragedy
data.description: Thailand's democracy "has never been fully fledged", said opposition leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut at an event marking the 50th anniversary of the Oct 6, 1976 massacre.

data.title: Opposition set to file censure bid
data.description: People's Party leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut said on Tuesday the opposition would soon submit a no-confidence motion, with the debate expected by late October or early next month.

data.title: NHRC raises concerns over public broadcaster funding
data.description: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) has expressed concern that proposed legislation to alter the funding sources of four public organisations could undermine media independence and affect fundamental public rights and freedoms.

data.title: Hospitals told to stock seven days of medicines
data.description: The Ministry of Public Health has ordered hospitals to stockpile enough medicines for at least seven days and food for 10 days ahead of more rain in the South next week.

data.title: Mother, daughters found dead after loan scam
data.description: A single mother and her two young daughters were found dead in their rented home in Pathum Thani on Tuesday after she was allegedly duped in a fraudulent loan application.

data.title: Families allege scam over taekwondo training fees
data.description: CHAIYAPHUM: Four families have asked police and the Sports Authority of Thailand (SAT) to investigate a taekwondo coach in Muang district after claiming they were ripped off.

data.title: Deluge pushes up vegetable, egg prices
data.description: Widespread flooding has disrupted agricultural production in several parts of Thailand, reducing supplies and pushing up vegetable and egg prices, Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun said.

data.title: Care home claims spark probe
data.description: The Public Health Ministry has launched an investigation into an elderly care home in Kanchanaburi's Tha Muang district following reports that residents were subjected to physical and psychological abuse and inhumane living conditions.
